CLERK_SECRET_KEY.description: Clerk says this must never be exposed on the frontend.

NEXT_PUBLIC_CLERK_PUBLISHABLE_KEY.description: Meant for the frontend. The key is the same whatever the framework; only the prefix on the name changes, so a Vite project calls it VITE_CLERK_PUBLISHABLE_KEY.

CLERK_WEBHOOK_SIGNING_SECRET.description: Verifies a webhook came from Clerk. No shape documented.
